profile.name: 矩形类图形组件
profile.description: 用于 Nion Swift 中的非物理图形组件，表示并编辑矩形类二维标注区域，如矩形或椭圆选区。它主要服务于图像/数据视图中的覆盖绘制、区域选择、拖拽调整、旋转、命中测试以及掩膜对象生成，不直接控制任何实验硬件。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software graphic component in Nion Swift for representing and editing rectangle-like 2D annotation regions, such as rectangular or elliptical selections. It is used for overlay drawing, region selection, drag adjustment, rotation, hit testing, and mask-item generation in image or data views, and does not directly control laboratory hardware.
